title: Audit and expand behavioral test coverage
description: Audit public CLI, task persistence, Git/worktree discovery, configuration, storage, legacy compatibility, export, updater, and release-contract behavior, then add deterministic focused tests for meaningful gaps. Prioritize nested paths, linked worktrees, detached HEAD, non-Git directories, paths with spaces, metadata defaults/overrides/clearing/preservation, .wtp.json and wtpDir failures, legacy commands, shell-script success and failure, backward-compatible task files, and no unintended storage or installation changes. Do not enforce a numeric coverage threshold; every new behavior and regression must have focused coverage. Acceptance: reviewable tests cover the identified gaps without external state or flaky dependencies.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Audit underway: existing coverage is strong for storage/context metadata and provider invariants; remaining gaps are full legacy command round-trips, shell-script success/failure contracts, updater/release negative paths, and public export/backward-compatibility behavior.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Implemented focused coverage and fixed the discovered legacy pause-agent rewrite regression. Added public legacy round-trip coverage for create/get/list/comment/start/pause/next/done/export; spaced-path export with byte-stable storage; config and wtpDir failure/no-migration checks; updater unsafe-URL rejection; and isolated Bash smoke/install success and failure tests. Verified go test ./..., go vet ./..., scripts/verify.sh commit, uncached targeted tests, race tests, Windows amd64/arm64 cross-compilation, and git diff --check.
